title: upload_blob response limit is hardcoded, not taken from ClientConfig
description: blob.rs upload_blob hardcodes UPLOAD_RESPONSE_LIMIT = 1 MiB as a local const instead of using a field from ClientConfig. Every other response cap (max_session_body, max_call_body, max_download_body) is configurable via ClientConfig. The upload response body cap should either be added to ClientConfig or explicitly documented as intentionally fixed — the current silent inconsistency is unexpected.
